def transform(g):
    h=[row[:] for row in g]
    zr=sorted({r for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==0})
    zc=sorted({c for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==0})
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if (r in zr or c in zc) and g[r][c] != 2:
                h[r][c]=0
    return h
pred_demo=transform(a)
print('demo matches',pred_demo==b)
pred_test=transform(grid)
print('test output:')
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in pred_test))
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    zero_rows = {r for r, row in enumerate(grid) for value in row if value == 0}\n    zero_cols = {c for row in grid for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0}\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        for c, value in enumerate(row):\n            if (r in zero_rows or c in zero_cols) and value != 2:\n                out[r][c] = 0\n    return out\n')
print('saved',p)
